meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 ETE 4 读写/转换 Newick、NHX 等树文件，执行剪枝、重根、树间比较等操作，也可做基因树进化事件检测、NCBI 分类注释，并输出 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当用户要求对系统发育树做常规处理（如读取、编辑、比较），检测基因树的复制/分化事件，或基于 NCBI 分类进行注释时触发。该技能不用于从原始序列直接推断树。

say.text: 读取这个 Newick 文件，按我给出的物种列表做剪枝
say.note: Claude 会加载树并剪枝，输出所需子集。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的 RF 距离，列出有差异的分支
say.note: Claude 会计算 RF 距离并指出拓扑差异。

say.text: 用 NCBI 分类库给这棵树的叶子加上谱系信息
say.note: Claude 会给叶子附上物种谱系与分类标注。

howto.what_en: Installed skill lets Claude work with phylogenetic or hierarchical trees via ETE 4: tree I/O and conversion, editing/comparison, evolutionary event detection, NCBI taxonomy annotation, and PDF/SVG visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user works with phylogenetic trees (reading/editing/comparing), detects gene-tree evolutionary events, or annotates via NCBI taxonomy. Not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read this Newick file and prune it to the species I list.
say_en.note: ETE loads the tree and prunes it.

say_en.text: Compare these two trees; list branches that differ.
say_en.note: Computes RF distance and divergent topologies.

say_en.text: Annotate each leaf of this tree with its NCBI lineage.
say_en.note: Adds NCBI taxid and lineage names to leaves.
